verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies page says it is present in venture hubs across several countries, naming London, Hong Kong and Singapore alongside its US offices. That is a first-party claim of its own multi-country footprint, and its privacy and trademark pages also describe global practice coverage. missing for 10: a full office/jurisdiction list, explicit confirmation of local-law-qualified lawyers in each country, independent corroboration of cross-border startup service.
